retrievalProfile.description: A cinematic urban aesthetic featuring a duo in a back-to-back pose against a desaturated, post-apocalyptic city backdrop with high-contrast lighting and futuristic typography.

recipe.visualDefinition: Two male figures positioned back-to-back in the foreground, wearing dark sunglasses and leather jackets. The lighting is harsh and directional, creating deep shadows and bright highlights on skin textures. The background is a hazy, desaturated urban landscape suggesting destruction or a sci-fi setting. A central metallic, sharp-edged emblem anchors the composition.
coreVisualRelationships: Symmetrical duo framing the central vertical axis
High contrast between dark leather textures and bright facial highlights
Futuristic, sharp-edged typography layered over gritty photographic textures
Desaturated cool-toned background vs. warm skin tones and red accents

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: Two large-scale portraits occupying the upper two-thirds of the frame, angled away from each other.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: A sharp, silver metallic 'W' shaped emblem located in the lower center.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eyes start at the faces, move down to the central logo, then out to the stylized text at the top and bottom edges.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: Minimal; the frame is densely packed with subjects and atmospheric haze.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Desaturated greys and blacks in clothing and background.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: High-value white highlights on skin and metallic surfaces.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Deep red for secondary display text.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Low saturation overall with high value contrast (chiaroscuro effect).
paletteRestrictions: Avoid vibrant primary colors except for small red accents

letterConstructionRules: Top text: Ultra-wide, low-profile sans-serif with horizontal emphasis
Bottom text: Highly stylized, abstract sci-fi characters with horizontal bars and disconnected strokes
Central text: Narrow, blocky sans-serif with sharp corners
characterSpecificRedesigns: Letters are often reduced to horizontal bars and sharp vertical stems
Crossbars are frequently removed or replaced with gaps
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Wide horizontal headers paired with condensed, blocky sub-headers and abstract decorative glyphs.

candidateDirections.reason: Provides the wide, square-jawed foundation for the top text.
Captures the tech-focused, wide geometric feel.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: Generate a cinematic photo of two men back-to-back wearing sunglasses and black leather jackets. Use high-contrast lighting with a desaturated, hazy urban ruins background. Leave space at the top and bottom for text.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Add a sharp metallic silver crest in the center. Place wide-tracked futuristic white text at the top and abstract, horizontally-stretched sci-fi lettering at the bottom in white and red.

verificationChecks: Is the lighting high-contrast with visible skin texture?
Is the typography horizontally stretched and futuristic?
Is the color palette primarily desaturated with red accents?

mustAchieve: Sharp metallic texture on the logo

postGenerationChecks: Check for high-contrast highlights on the faces
Ensure the central emblem looks metallic and sharp
Verify the bottom text is abstract and horizontally stretched
Confirm the background is desaturated and atmospheric
recipe.reuseFormula: Duo Portrait + Back-to-Back Pose + High Contrast Lighting + Desaturated Urban Haze + Futuristic Wide Typography + Metallic Central Emblem.
